<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1458
Claimant:
Steve Kelly
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
14 Nov 2024
First notice of loss came in by phone from the driver, who reported a low-speed head-on collision at a residential
intersection. The drievr is named on the policy, and I confirmed the vehicle and coverage details before assigning the
file.
25 Nov 2024
Spoke with the claimant, who is not represented by an attorney, and took a recorded statement describing the impact
and the seat position at the time. The account was consistent with the damage reported at intake.
30 Nov 2024
The responding officer's report and two witnesses at the scene confirm the claimant was in the vehicle when it was
struck. No independent witness saw the moment of impact itself.
21 Jan 2025
Reviewed the photos submitted by the claimant. They confirm the location of the front-end damage and the airbag
status, but it is unclear whether all of the visible damage came from this single impact.
31 Mar 2025
The claimant reported neck and back pain and was seen at urgent care. The reported injury is plausible for a collision
of this type, and no prior injury to the same body area appears in the records available to me.
11 Apr 2025
Received a call from a neighbor who believes the vehicle was already damaged some weeks before the claimed loss.
The information is secondhand, and I have not yet been able to verify it with the claimant or other sources.
15 Apr 2025
Checked the vehicle history and prior claims. No earlier damage to the vehicle is on record, though the search does
not cover unreported repairs. I am requesting the repair estimates and the shop's intake photos to compare.
30 Apr 2025
Followed up with the claimant, who again gave the same account of the collision and the sequence of events as in
every prior contact. Treatment has followed a usual course, with phsyical therapy visits tapering off as symptoms
improved.
23 May 2025
Reviewing the file with the treatment records, the photos, and the repair estimates in hand. The injury appears
consistent with the mechanics of the collision, and the open question is the extent of vehicle damage attributable to
this impact. Next step is to obtain an independent estimate and the neighbor's contact details for a follow-up
statement.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
